# Fill a float64 slice with zero (broadcast constant).

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func ZeroFloat64s(dst []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func ZeroFloat64s(dst []float64) {
	_vcFloat64s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(0)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_n := _vcFloat64s0.StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	dst := []float64{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}
	test.ZeroFloat64s(dst)
	fmt.Println(dst)
}
-- testmain/output --
[0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0]
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func ZeroFloat64s(dst []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0
	}
}
